name: Electronic City, Bangalore
desc: Electronic City insurance advisor for Infosys, Wipro, HCL, and tech park professionals. Hari Kotian provides doorstep claim support and term insurance advisory. IRDAI Reg No: 0149161D.
it_focus: Electronic City has 200,000+ tech professionals. We offer term insurance with critical illness riders for Infosys/Wipro employees, Super Top-Up health plans covering Narayana Health and Apollo Electronic City, and seamless portability when changing employers.
senior_focus: Senior residents in nearby townships get LIC claim support, pension advisory, and health insurance portability.
branch_dets: Direct coordination with LIC branches in Electronic City Phase 1 and 2. Same-day claim escalation.

local_faqs.question: Cashless hospitals in Electronic City?
local_faqs.answer: Narayana Health (Electronic City), Apollo Clinic (Phase 1), Aster (Near Infosys), Fortis (Bannerghatta Road nearby). Full pre-authorization handled.

local_faqs.question: Term insurance for Infosys/Wipro employees?
local_faqs.answer: Plans with flexible premium payment, critical illness rider (36 diseases), and global cover for onsite assignments. HDFC, ICICI Pru, Max, Tata AIA options.

local_faqs.question: Group health for tech companies?
local_faqs.answer: Custom group plans with OPD, maternity, wellness, and telemedicine. Premium optimization for 50-5000 employee organizations.

local_faqs.question: Motor insurance in Electronic City?
local_faqs.answer: Doorstep renewal with zero-depreciation, engine protection, and consumables cover for long commute vehicles.
